## Current Focus (as of 2026-07-05)

### Woodworking

- **Bookshelf build** — glue-up done, sanding the walnut face frame next. Working
  from the [[projects/active/bookshelf/plan]] and tracking day-to-day state in the
  build's registry at [[projects/active/bookshelf/]]. Photos going into the build log.
- **Trail signage** — routing the second batch of cedar blanks this weekend.

### Health

- Knee rehab is the open thread — see [[knee-injury]]. Next physio appointment is
  on the calendar; logging range-of-motion after each session.

### Astronomy

- Partway through the study course; the [[telescope-setup]] notes cover collimation
  so I stop re-learning it every dark-sky weekend.

### Loose ends

- Still need to write up the barred-owl sighting from the north loop — the note
  references [[does-not-exist]] until I create the wildlife log.
